'''Ginbotham''' was a male [[Hig]] who served aboard the [[Yavin (starship)|''Yavin'']] in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]] as part of the command crew, alongside [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]].

==Biography==
Ginbotham was a blue-skinned, slender [[Hig]]. In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], he served in the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Forces]]. He was renowned for his [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] skills and served as part of the command crew aboard the [[Yavin (starship)|''Yavin'']], a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruiser]] under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]. While serving aboard the ''Yavin'', Ginbotham saw action at the [[Battle of Almania]], where the Republic engaged three [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]] under the command of the terrorist [[Kueller]]. Ginbotham was ordered to fire at one of the Republic's allied ships, the ''[[Wild Karrde]]'', in order to confuse the opponent's [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-operated forces into mistaking the ''Yavin'' for one of their own ships.<ref name="TNR" />
